testcase.name: Scenario: extrusion-20 Dimension pick can change the active distance expression: mnt/vininas-projects/MCAD-Scenarios/features/solid-model/extrusion/extrusion.feature:206:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: extrusion-20 Dimension pick can change the active distance expression ✔> Given the MCAD Software is displaying a part in the solid modeling workspace ✔> And the viewport pointer is idle ✔ Given a copy of `fixtures/cad/extrusion/extrusion-dimension-pick.opd` is open with a rectangle and separate 3 mm circle dimensioned as d2 ✔ And the rectangular profile is selected in an active Extrude preview ✔ When the user opens the Distance A editor menu and chooses Measure ✔ Then the status area asks the user to select a dimension to reference the parameter ✔ When the circle dimension annotation is picked ✔ Then Distance A references d2 instead of adding another profile ✔ And a later pick produces invalid d2d2 and disabled OK ✔ When Cancel is clicked ✔ Then no new extrusion is accepted
